title: Finite-Cohort Transfer of Honest Risk-Difference Intervals in Nested Case-Control Sampling
banked_reason: The explicit finite-N transfer package remains below the field floor: neither a matched lower bound, a strict published case-cohort improvement, nor a certified same-experiment procedure comparison is supplied.
gap_reasons: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: the targets give a model-specific value-transfer and a proposed certification handle, but neither commits a rate, a matched/sharper statistical bound, an attaining efficiency result, coverage limit law, or a first quantified bound relative to a named comparator.

The displayed rates quantify convergence between two newly defined minimax decision experiments, but the core supplies neither a matched lower bound, a strict improvement over a published case-cohort bound, nor a first nontrivial bound for a named published estimator or estimand.
Revise around a genuine statistical frontier—preferably an unavoidable noisy-margin lower bound or a strict published-procedure comparison—before advancing to Stage 0.
proof_attempt_summary: Replaced the asymptotic-only proposal with explicit finite-N coupling, moving-fiber, coverage-repair, and label-rank transfer bounds. The revision repaired coherence and quantified proposed exact honesty, but both reviewers retained letter-tier novelty and independent MAIN validity confirmed incremental below-floor convergence. D0 and F stages were not entered: no informal completed derivation or Lean certification was produced; certified full-class computation and a matched lower bound or strict same-experiment comparator remain open.
tldr: The primary result is an explicit uniform finite-\(N\) transfer of minimax \(90\%\) honest interval length and clipped squared risk from the complete labeled cohort to the randomized marked-Poisson benchmark for a prevalence-normalized causal risk difference. The error budget separately charges rare-Bernoulli Poissonization, the random cohort margin, finite control supply, noncase marks, moving-fiber transport, coverage repair, and mesh-dependent label-rank implementation. Deterministic labeled-cohort intervals have exact finite-\(N\) honesty, with length transfer rate \(O(\sqrt{\log N/N})\); squared-risk transfer is \(O(N^{-1/2})\). Uniformly terminating, directed-arithmetic certificates over the full compact class remain the first-class open question. The zero-assay floor, positive randomization gap, finite-program brackets, and robust-budget dominance condition are supporting diagnostics and consequences.
gap: Classical Poisson approximation, data randomization, and compact minimax confidence-set theory do not supply their joint explicit finite-\(N\), all-law transfer for this normalized terminal-noncase experiment. Regular two-phase asymptotic variance criteria address a different information regime.
fill: The finite-cohort transfer theorem quantifies each experiment and implementation error, preserves exact \(90\%\) coverage, and yields conservative rates without extra smoothness, interiority, or attainment assumptions. Certified legal normalization-fiber covers and rational optimization receipts form the unresolved computation question.
